# ![](https://app.gusto.com/companies/7ef262d8-6e96-469a-9345-408b5770e8f5/logo?v=1756138686)    8bitstudio / Anthem, IncContent Marketing Strategist  Remote  ·   Full time      [Apply for Content Marketing Strategist](https://jobs.gusto.com/postings/8bitstudio-anthem-inc-content-marketing-strategist-0893a49d-0178-4fc3-9681-102e82af69a5/applicants/new)

We’re looking for a Content Marketing Strategist who can own messaging, bring clarity to complex ideas, and lead content and social strategy for ambitious brands. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution—shaping website messaging, managing social presence, and supporting SEO and campaigns through better content and storytelling. If you’re equal parts thinker and doer, you’ll feel at home here.

### About 8bitstudio / Anthem, Inc

Established in 2005, 8bitstudio embarked on a mission to produce websites for organizations that would genuinely captivate their audience. Recognizing a gap in the standard quality of websites at that time, we eagerly embraced the challenge of pushing boundaries. With a steadfast commitment to user-centric design, 8bitstudio endeavored to create meticulously customized websites, ensuring that each aspect catered to the user's needs. To this day, our team remains unwavering in our pursuit of excellence, refusing to settle for anything less than the best.

In 2020, Anthem was established as the overarching organization for 8bitstudio. Anthem's purpose is to support both 8bitstudio and our team in concentrating on our broader objective – a mission to create a positive impact within our community and the larger world around us.

### Description

# Content Marketing Strategist

**8bitstudio – Hutchinson, MN (Remote/Hybrid Considered)**

### About 8bitstudio

8bitstudio is a high-design digital agency that partners with ambitious brands to create custom websites and digital marketing strategies that actually move the needle. We don’t do templates. We don’t do cookie-cutter marketing. We build thoughtful, strategic, high-impact digital experiences for organizations that care about quality, growth, and standing out.

## The Role

This is a strategic, hands-on role at the center of our marketing work.

You will be responsible for:

- Shaping messaging and positioning
- Leading content strategy for websites and campaigns
- Managing social media presence
- Supporting SEO and paid efforts through better content and clarity

You will be the person who brings structure to ideas, clarity to messaging, and consistency across channels.

## What You’ll Do

### Content & Messaging Strategy

- Own messaging and positioning for client brands
- Develop content strategies for new website builds and redesigns
- Translate business goals, services, and differentiators into clear, compelling messaging
- Help define and maintain brand voice across all channels

### Website Content Development

- Plan page structure, content hierarchy, and messaging flow
- Write or coordinate website copy (home, services, landing pages, etc.)
- Gather content from clients through interviews, working sessions, and guided processes
- Partner closely with our design and development team to ensure content and UX work together

### Social Media Strategy & Management

- Develop social strategies for multiple client accounts
- Build and manage content calendars
- Write and schedule posts across platforms (primarily Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram)
- Ensure consistency with brand voice and marketing goals
- Monitor performance and adjust strategy as needed

### SEO & Campaign Support

- Collaborate with our SEO/Paid specialist on keyword strategy and content opportunities
- Optimize on-page content for search and conversion
- Support paid campaigns with ad copy, messaging direction, and landing page content
- Identify content gaps and opportunities to improve performance

### Client Collaboration

- Lead content-focused client conversations and working sessions
- Guide clients through content development without overwhelming them
- Act as a strategic partner, not just an order taker

## What We’re Looking For

- 2+ years experience in content marketing, digital marketing, or agency environment
- Strong writing skills and a sharp eye for messaging, tone, and clarity
- Experience managing social media for brands or clients
- Solid understanding of how content supports SEO, conversion, and lead generation
- Comfortable working across multiple clients and projects
- Strategic thinker who can also execute
- Organized, proactive, and able to take ownership
- Confident and professional in client-facing situations
- Experience with WordPress CMS

## Bonus Points (Not Required)

- Agency experience
- Experience collaborating with designers and developers
- Familiarity with tools like HubSpot, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar
- Experience with brand development or positioning work

## Why 8bitstudio?

- Small, tight-knit team where your work has real impact
- High design standards and meaningful client work
- Opportunity to shape how we deliver content marketing as we grow
- Variety of projects and industries
- No corporate bureaucracy. No fluff. Just smart people doing good work.

[Apply for Content Marketing Strategist](https://jobs.gusto.com/postings/8bitstudio-anthem-inc-content-marketing-strategist-0893a49d-0178-4fc3-9681-102e82af69a5/applicants/new)
